Read out of saint.gr's line for 30 Οκτωβρίου, «Άγιοι Τέρτιος, Μάρκος, Ιούστος και Αρτεμάς οι Απόστολοι από τους Εβδομήκοντα», with the rank words left off.
Read out of the title on his name link behind the line for 30 октября ст. ст., «Апостол от 70-ти Тертий», with the rank words left off. The line itself declines the name, «Тертия».

feast.note: The Greek calendar keeps the same four apostles on its own 30 October and the Romanian keeps this one on 10 noiembrie; this is the Russian calendar's own day and not a second day on one calendar. His name page lists «4 января (70 ап.)», the synaxis of the Seventy, and «30 октября»; one row per church is the schema, so the synaxis is recorded here and he does not render on it.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 30 октября ст. ст. — «Апп. от 70-ти Тертия , Марка , Иуста и Артемы (I).»
source.note: The line is the second of the day. The day carries one typikon sign only, «Cовершается служба, не отмеченная в Типиконе никаким знаком», so no rank is recorded.

attestations.note: The Russian prints the same four names as the Greek line this folder's Greek row quotes, and its one life for the four adds to his notice a people and a death: that he turned many of the pagans of Iconium to Christ, and that he ended his life there as a martyr. The see and the predecessor are the Greek page's as well. The calendar's index of lives under his name serves a third page besides the four's and his own, headed «Священномученик Терентий, епископ Иконийский», whose «Дни памяти» include this day and the Romanian's 10 November and which has that man killed by a sharpened stake; the corpus keeps no folder of that name and see, nothing here folds the two names, and the folder takes only what the four's own life says.

source.text: doxologia.ro, calendarul pentru 10 noiembrie — «Sfântul Apostol Terţiu»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 30ης Οκτωβρίου — «Άγιοι Τέρτιος, Μάρκος, Ιούστος και Αρτεμάς οι Απόστολοι από τους Εβδομήκοντα»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 30 Οκτωβρίου εκάστου έτους». The folder's Romanian row keeps him on 10 November, a different day, and that row is not touched: this is the Greek calendar's own day for the same man, and he is identified not by his name but by what the page says of him — second bishop of Iconium after Sosipater, and the man who wrote down Saint Paul's letter to the Romans, as he says himself at Romans 16.22. The entry enumerates four apostles of the Seventy; two of them, Artemas of Lystra and Justus of Eleutheropolis, are new folders of this batch, and the fourth, Mark, is reported and not drafted because the corpus's Mark of Apollonias already carries a venerated Greek row on 16 June. No year, so the folder's dateless state is unchanged. No hymn on this page. No asterisk and not the sentence «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη η ύπαρξη του Αγίου».
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs (25 September 2026).

hymns.text: Sfinţilor Apostoli, rugaţi pe Milostivul Dumnezeu ca să dea iertare de greşeli sufletelor noastre.

source.text: Doxologia — «Troparul Sfinților Apostoli Olimp, Rodion, Sosipatru, Erast, Terțiu, Cvart» (a common of the apostles, printed once for the whole company of the day)

english.text: Holy Apostles, pray to the merciful God that He grant our souls forgiveness of our offences.

death.note: days.pravoslavie.ru's line for 30 октября ст. ст. closes the four apostles with «(I)», the first century, and its life for them gives no year. The folder held no `dates` before this: neither doxologia.ro nor saint.gr dated him at all.
